purpose: Freeze source identities, deterministic case selection, and human evidence assessments before producing the derived W8-T4 classification artifact.

selection.rule: Analyze every W8-T1 answerable case with a saved execution, retrieval-recall, required-keyword, document-citation, or strict-chunk-citation signal; analyze every W8-T2 non-correct-abstention or execution-failure case; add three answerable and two unanswerable success controls.

manual_evidence_review_method.method: Compare expected answer and labels with the saved answer, candidate/final/context identities and contents, and pipeline citations. Record answer/citation assessments only; do not pre-assign failure labels.
